mapper.sql: NOTICE_SN, TITLE, CONTENT, TARGET_TYPE_CD, SEND_TIMING_CD, SCHEDULED_AT, PUBLISHED_AT, NOTICE_STTS_CD, NOTIFY_SEND_YN, REG_DT
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO NOTICE (TITLE, CONTENT, TARGET_TYPE_CD, SEND_TIMING_CD, SCHEDULED_AT, PUBLISHED_AT, NOTICE_STTS_CD, NOTIFY_SEND_YN, REG_DT, RGTR_SN, MDFCN_DT, MDFR_SN) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{targetTypeCd}, #{sendTimingCd}, #{scheduledAt}, #{publishedAt}, #{noticeSttsCd}, #{notifySendYn}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), #{rgtrSn}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), #{rgtrSn})
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM NOTICE
ORDER BY NOTICE_SN DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT FROM NOTICE WHERE NOTICE_SN = #{noticeSn} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.update: UPDATE NOTICE SET TITLE = #{title}, CONTENT = #{content}, TARGET_TYPE_CD = #{targetTypeCd}, SEND_TIMING_CD = #{sendTimingCd}, SCHEDULED_AT = #{scheduledAt}, MDFCN_DT = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), MDFR_SN = #{mdfrSn} WHERE NOTICE_SN = #{noticeSn} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
UPDATE NOTICE SET NOTICE_STTS_CD = 'CLOSED', MDFCN_DT = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), MDFR_SN = #{mdfrSn} WHERE NOTICE_SN = #{noticeSn} AND NOTICE_STTS_CD = 'PUBLISHED_ONGOING' AND DEL_YN = 'N'

UPDATE NOTICE SET NOTICE_STTS_CD = 'PUBLISHED_ONGOING', PUBLISHED_AT = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), NOTIFY_SEND_YN = 'Y', MDFCN_DT = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE NOTICE_STTS_CD = 'SCHEDULED' AND SCHEDULED_AT IS NOT NULL AND SCHEDULED_AT <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND DEL_YN = 'N'
